第1章(1)

红盖头被挑开以后，呈现在烛光下的是一张娇俏芙蓉面，眼是水波横，眉是黛峰聚，琼瑶鼻，樱桃唇，实实在在的美丽佳人。

洞房中原本等着看热闹的媳妇、小姑娘们都瞪大了眼睛，似乎没想到传言中克死过三个未婚夫的‘扫把星’居然是这样一个大美人，她们以前都猜测一定是个面丑心恶的可怕女子呢。

当新郎倌冷冷的视线在房中扫了一圈，凑热闹的女人们才像惊醒过来一般，急忙挤出大大的笑脸，七嘴八舌地赞叹起来新娘子的天姿丽色。

喜婆子也来凑趣，说：“新娘子美貌可人，好比天仙下凡，与咱们老爷文曲星下凡正好是天生一对，恭喜老爷，贺喜老爷了。”

新郎馆严肃刻板的英俊面庞总算露出些微笑意，但也只是点了点头。

喜婆子又伺候着新郎新娘将衣带结在一起，结成同心结，然后两人并坐着喝了交杯酒，就算礼成了。

新郎馆之后还要去前庭招待宾客，因此喜婆子将两人的衣襟重新解开以后，他就站了起来，看了看房中的女人们，淡淡地道：“忙碌了一整天，大伙儿也该饿了累了，前面我让人准备了上好的酒席，各位请入席吧。”

话说得好听，但明显就是要把人从洞房里赶出去了。

小媳妇和姑娘们互相望望，好吧，人家新郎倌心疼新娘子，不忍心被闹洞房折腾着玩了，咱们也别惹人嫌，走人吧。

等人都散干净了，新郎叫进了自己的贴身大丫鬟知微、知柔，以及新娘子的陪嫁大丫鬟和烟、和霞，命令她们准备热水给新娘子梳洗，史吩咐等会儿先让新娘子吃点饭食，别一直干等着他回来。

四个大丫鬟齐齐屈膝，恭敬应了声‘是’，尤其是和烟与和霞，觉得新郎馆实在威严不可亲，好像万一有一点儿做得不好，就会被严惩。

等新郎走出房门，和烟与和霞悄悄对视一眼，调皮的和霞悄悄吐了吐舌头，眨眨眼，用口型对着和烟暗道：厉害！

和烟心有余悸的点头，原本以为新郎娶了如今第一世家原府唯一的千金小姐是高攀了，更何况他还是续弦，她家小姐进门还不是原配，只能屈居继室，实在是太委屈了，可是如今看到新郎严肃端庄又英俊逼人的样子，和烟与和霞也不敢再存了轻视怠慢的心思，现在她们反而要为自家小姐担心了，不知道这位曾经连中三元的状元老爷会不会很难伺候？会不会苛待她们小姐啊？

说起来她们小姐原宜之样样皆好，要容貌有容貌，要才学有才学，女红针黹，琴棋书画，样样都有涉猎，并且大部分还很精通。美貌可人，温桑贤淑，知书达理，这样的女子打着灯笼全天下也找不到几个，可她们堪称十全十美的小姐，只有一样不好，而且还是致命的缺陷——命不好。

算命先生说小姐命硬，克夫，搞不好还会克子。

可不是吗？自从原宜之十一岁开始议亲以来，前后说了三门亲事，都是出身良好世家的公子，结果原本身体健康的三位公子都先后死去了，或因疾病，或因意外事故，都是仓促去世，让人一点心理准备都没有，也让对方的父母家人痛不欲生。

原府位高爵显，乃当今第一世家，议亲的人家不敢追究，可是原宜之克夫的传言已经遍及京师，自她十六岁之后，再也没有正经人家敢和她议亲。

如今原宜之已经二十岁，算是老姑娘了，父母为了她的婚事实在发愁，好不容易有个出身、相貌、才华、前程都还不错的人主动上门提亲，原府的当家主母郑氏自然大喜过望，可是详细一打听，才知道此人已经过了而立之年，足足比原宜之大了十岁，而且还是续弦，先前的原配夫人因难产去世几年了，只留下个遗腹子病恹恹的，还不知道能不能成人。

好好的黄花大闺女，谁愿意去做解夫的继室填房呢？如果先前的原配夫人美有留下子嗣还好点，可如今还留下一个嫡子，那麻烦就更大，一进门就要做娘，遇到这种事，谁也不会多开心。

郑氏为此很是犹豫，于是转身和当家老爷原北顾商量，也询问了原宜之生母周姨娘的意见，周姨娘也是犹豫，觉得不好想推拒，可是自家女儿克夫的传言实在要命，又怕错过这村再没这店，女儿总不能做一辈子的老姑娘不嫁人吧？

原北顾对唯一的女儿很是疼爱，为此特意命几个儿子多方打听此人的家世、为人、才学、经历等等，再三调查的结果都很令他满意，而且此人如今正得皇帝的青睐，前程无限光明远大，虽然做继室有点委屈了宝贝女儿，但原宜之说起来也只是姨娘生的庶女，又有个克夫的不良名声，能遇到这样的婚事，也算万幸了。

于是在耽搁了半年之久后，景国立国以来目前唯一连中三元的状元郎谢雍成为了原府的女婿，原宜之的夫婿。

科举制度称乡试、会试、殿试的第一名分别为谢元、会元、状元，合成‘三元’；接连在乡试、会试、殿试三场大考中，都考中了第一名，便称‘连中三元’。

这种人，百年难出一个，如果真出了一个，那绝对是全国轰动，连当时在位的皇帝都会觉得脸上增光，与有荣焉。

连中三元，对于文人来说，是无上的荣宠，子孙都能够跟着沾光几辈子。

‘连中三元’与‘三元及弟’还是有区别的，连中三元也属于三元及第，但三元及第不一定是连中三元。

三元及第虽然也是乡试、会试、殿试都中过头一名，但是在三场大考中，基本上是指的在乡试与会试之间可能间隔了几年，甚至乡试、会试中部可能落榜过，隔过几年再考，中了第一名，也能称为‘三元及第’。

连中三元的要求就极度严苛了，以谢雍为例，他秋闱参加乡试中了第一名，紧接着次年春闱参加会试仍然中了第一名，再之后的殿试又被皇帝御笔钦点为状元，三场大考不能有中断与间隔，这才叫‘连中三元’。

要知道每场科考的主考官都不同，主考官的喜好也不同，要想让每场科考的主考官都钦点同一人为第一名，这种机率实在罕见。

历史上的每个朝代或长或短，两、三百年，或者三、五百年间，能出现一两名连中三元者就很是荣幸了，很多朝代甚至终此一朝都可能遇不到一个。

谢雍少年就富有才名，十三岁就过了院试，成为生员秀才，可是随后他的父亲病逝，他守孝三年，本来他十六岁打算参加乡试，结果母亲又大病，时人以孝为先，他为照顾母亲又荒废了三年。

直到十九岁他才正式参加科举，然后就在乡试、会试、殿试中一帆风顺连中三元，成为状元后他被当时的宰相，也是他那一科的主考官丁士章相中，极力推荐自家的女儿给谢雍，当时还算年少皮薄的谢雍推却不过师恩盛情，再加上寡母也满意攀上这门贵戚，于是就娶了丁家女儿丁锦绣为妻。

丁锦绣出身尊贵，又是嫡女，性格难免有点骄纵，婚后多次与婆婆发生争执，甚至后来谢母一怒之下离开京城，返回老家居住。

丁锦绣入门三年没有生育，谢母以无子为名，赐给儿子一个小妾玲珑；锦绣不甘示弱，抬举了自己的陪嫁丫鬟青黛为妾，婆媳二人继续斗法。

Chapter 1(1)

After the red hijab was lifted, what appeared under the candlelight was a pretty face with ripples of water, eyebrows with peaked eyebrows, a beautiful nose, and cherry lips. She was a truly beautiful lady.

The daughters-in-law and young girls in the bridal chamber who were waiting to watch the excitement all widened their eyes. They seemed to have never expected that the 'broom star' who was rumored to have killed three fiancés was actually such a great beauty. They had previously guessed that she must be a terrible woman with an ugly face and a disgusting heart.

When the groom's cold gaze swept around the room, the women who were joining in the fun seemed to have woken up, hurriedly smiling widely and praising the bride's beauty.

Mrs. Xi also came to join in the fun and said: "The bride is so beautiful that she is like a fairy descending to earth. She is a perfect match for our master Wen Quxing. Congratulations to the master. Congratulations to the master."

The groom's serious and handsome face finally showed a smile, but he just nodded.

The happy mother-in-law then helped the bride and groom tie their clothes together into a concentric knot, and then the two of them sat side by side and drank a glass of wine, and the ceremony was considered complete.

After the groom's pavilion, he had to go to the vestibule to entertain the guests, so after Mrs. Xi untied the clothes of the two of them, he stood up, looked at the women in the room, and said calmly: "You have been busy all day, and you must be hungry and tired. I have asked someone to prepare a good banquet ahead of you. Please come and take a seat."

It sounded nice, but it was obvious that he wanted to drive the person out of the bridal chamber.

The young daughter-in-law and the girls looked at each other, okay, the groom feels sorry for the bride and can't bear to be tormented by the bridal chamber, so let's not cause trouble and leave.

After everyone had dispersed, the groom called in his personal maids Zhiwei and Zhirou, as well as the bride's dowry maids Yan and Hexia, and ordered them to prepare hot water for the bride to wash herself. Shi told the bride to have some food later and not wait for him to come back.

The four maids all knelt down and said "yes" respectfully. Especially He Yan and He Xia, who felt that the groom's hall was really majestic and inaccessible, as if they would be severely punished if they did anything wrong.

When the groom walked out of the room, He Yan and He Xia secretly looked at each other. The naughty He Xia quietly stuck out her tongue, blinked, and secretly said to He Yan with her mouth: Awesome!

He Yanxin nodded with lingering fear. She originally thought that the groom was overachieving by marrying the only daughter of the first family, not to mention that he still had a second marriage. Her daughter was not the first wife when she entered the house, so she had to be the second wife. It was really unfair, but ifSeeing the groom's solemn, dignified and handsome appearance, He Yan and He Xia no longer dare to be contemptuous and indifferent. Now they have to worry about their young lady. I wonder if this man who once won three consecutive No. 1 prizes will be difficult to serve?Will they treat their ladies harshly?

Speaking of which, their young lady Yuan Yi is good at everything, she should be good-looking, talented and knowledgeable, be it needlework, chess, calligraphy or painting, she is involved in everything, and most of them are proficient in it.There are not many women in the world who are beautiful, gentle, virtuous, and well-educated. However, they can be called perfect young ladies. There is only one bad thing, and it is a fatal flaw - bad life.

The fortune teller said that the young lady has a hard luck and will be a bad boy, and she might even be a bad boy.

Isn't it?Since Yuan Yizhi started discussing marriage at the age of eleven, he has arranged marriages with three families, all of whom were young masters from good families. As a result, the three young masters who were originally in good health all died one after another, either due to illness or accidents. They all died hastily, which made people unprepared at all, and also made each other's parents and family members miserable.

Yuan Mansion is a high-ranking family, and it is the first family in the world. People who propose marriage dare not pursue it. However, the rumors of Yuan Yi's husband have spread all over the capital. After she was sixteen years old, no serious family dared to propose marriage to her.

Yuan Yizhi is now twenty years old and can be considered an old girl. Her parents are really worried about her marriage. Finally, someone with a good background, appearance, talent, and future comes to propose marriage. The head of the Yuan Mansion, Mrs. Zheng, is naturally overjoyed.However, after inquiring in detail, I found out that this person was past his thirties, ten years older than Yuan Yizhi, and he was still married. His previous wife had died due to dystocia a few years ago, leaving only a posthumous son who was very sick. It was not known whether he would be able to grow up.

A good young lady, who would want to be her husband’s step-in-law to fill the house?It would have been better if the original wife, Mei, had left an heir, but now she still has a legitimate son, and the trouble would be even greater. She would become a mother as soon as she entered the house. No one would be happy when this happens.

Mrs. Zheng was very hesitant about this, so she turned around to discuss with the head of the family, Yuan Beigu, and also asked Yuan Yizhi's biological mother, Aunt Zhou, for her opinion. Aunt Zhou was also hesitant and felt bad about rejecting it, but the rumors about her daughter Kefu were really terrible, and she was afraid of missing out and there would be no such shop in the village. Her daughter couldn't stay an old girl for the rest of her life without getting married, right?

Yuan Beigu loved his only daughter very much. For this reason, he specially ordered his sons to inquire about this person's family background, personality, talents, experience, etc. The results of repeated investigations were very satisfactory to him. Moreover, this person was now favored by the emperor and had a bright future. Although being a stepmother was a bit unfair to his precious daughter, Yuan Yizhi was just a concubine born to his aunt and had a bad reputation as a husband. It was lucky to meet such a marriage.

So after a delay of half a year, Xie Yong, the only number one scholar since the founding of Jingguo who won three consecutive prizes, became the son-in-law of Yuan Mansion and the husband-in-law of Yuan Yizhi.

In the imperial examination system, the first place in the provincial examination, the joint examination, and the palace examination are called Xie Yuan, Hui Yuan, and Zhuang Yuan respectively, which are combined into the "three yuan"; those who get the first place in the three major examinations of the provincial examination, the joint examination, and the palace examination are called "three consecutive winners."

It is rare for such a person to appear in a hundred years. If one does appear, it will definitely cause a sensation in the whole country. Even the emperor who was reigning at the time would feel that his face would be embellished and honored.

Winning three yuan in a row is a supreme honor for literati, and their descendants can follow it for several lifetimes.

There is a difference between "three yuan in a row" and "three yuan in a row". Three yuan in a row also belongs to the three yuan and the third yuan, but the three yuan and the third yuan are not necessarily three yuan in a row.

Although San Yuan and the first place in the provincial examination, the joint examination, and the imperial examination, in the three major examinations, it basically means that there may be a few years between the provincial examination and the joint examination. You may even have failed in the middle part of the provincial examination and the joint examination. If you take the exam again after a few years and get the first place, it can also be called the 'three yuan and first place'.

The requirements for winning three yuan in a row are extremely stringent. Take Xie Yong as an example. He took the first place in the provincial examination in autumn, and he still won the first place in the joint examination in the spring of the following year. In the subsequent palace examination, he was selected as the top scholar by the emperor's imperial pen. There should be no interruption or interval in the three major examinations. This is called "three yuan in a row".

You must know that the examiner of each scientific examination is different, and the examiner's preferences are also different. It is really rare for the examiner of each scientific examination to appoint the same person as the first place.

Every dynasty in history may be long or short. Within two or three hundred years, or three or five hundred years, it would be a great honor to have one or two people who have won the Three Elements in a row. In many dynasties, you may not even meet one for the entirety of the dynasty.

Xie Yong was rich and talented at a young age. He passed the hospital examination at the age of thirteen and became a scholar. However, his father died of illness and he remained filial piety for three years. Originally, he planned to take the provincial examination when he was sixteen, but his mother became seriously ill again. People at that time put filial piety first, so he spent another three years taking care of his mother.

He did not formally participate in the imperial examination until he was nineteen years old, and then he won three points in the provincial examination, the joint examination, and the palace examination smoothly. After becoming the number one scholar, he was selected by the prime minister at the time and the examiner of his subject, Ding Shizhang, who strongly recommended his daughter to Xie Yong.

Ding Jinxiu was born into a noble family and was a legitimate daughter. Her character was inevitably a bit arrogant. After her marriage, she had many disputes with her mother-in-law. Later, Xie's mother even left the capital in anger and returned to her hometown to live.

Ding Jinxiu had been childless for three years, so Xie's mother gave her son a concubine, Linglong, in the name of being childless. Jinxiu, not to be outdone, promoted her dowry maid Qingdai as a concubine, and the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law continued to fight.
